page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor delivers modest performance, with single-core and multi-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores falling into the bottom 25%. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression are also limited, ranking in the bottom 10%. However, the instance demonstrates average performance in large-block memory bandwidth read and write tests, as well as Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests. Redis SET operations and small-model LLM inference tasks also achieve average throughput, while database operations and static web serving remain in the lower performance tier.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8, the ecs.se1.2xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require high-performance compute or local storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing, though the older Intel Xeon architecture presents a tradeoff in raw processing speed compared to newer generations. This instance is best suited for memory-intensive applications such as caching layers, Redis deployments, and moderate database operations where RAM capacity is prioritized over high CPU throughput.
